thread.title: Barone's ninth-inning home run secures Liberty Flames' win over New Mexico State
thread.title_full: Barone's ninth-inning home run secures Liberty Flames' win over New Mexico State

author: b. t. santiago
title: Barone's ninth-inning home run secures Liberty Flames' win over New Mexico State
text:
Liberty University’s baseball team defeated New Mexico State 9-7 on May 3, after left fielder Nick Barone hit a three-run home run in the top of the ninth inning at Presley Askew Field in Las Cruces, New Mexico.
The victory came after Liberty trailed by four runs in the sixth inning. The Flames scored six unanswered runs to come back and win. In the seventh inning, two-out singles from first baseman Jaxon Sorenson and Barone helped reduce the deficit to one run. During the ninth, right fielder Riley DeCandido led off with a single and advanced to scoring position following an error. After a sacrifice bunt by Sorenson moved both runners forward, Barone hit his tenth home run of the season to give Liberty a lead they would not relinquish.
Relief pitcher Cooper Harrington closed out the game with a scoreless bottom of the ninth, earning his eighth save of the season. Tyler August entered as reliever during the sixth inning and allowed only two hits over nearly three innings without giving up any runs or walks while striking out four batters.
Barone finished with two hits and four runs batted in for Liberty. Sorenson also had two hits and drove in three runs; DeCandido contributed two hits, an RBI, and scored three times. The Aggies outhit Liberty 16-9 but committed three errors compared to none for Liberty.
With this result, Liberty secured their fifth consecutive win and clinched their current series against New Mexico State ahead of one remaining game. Their record improved to 17-6 in Conference USA play (34-13 overall), while New Mexico State dropped to 8-15 in conference games (19-26 overall). The teams are scheduled to play again Saturday evening.
